subject: 教育 (Education)
sentence: Students should be encouraged from using large language models for homework.
sentence_chinese: 应当鼓励学生使用大语言模型完成作业。

subject: 教育 (Education)
sentence: The academic workload of primary school students should be reduced.
sentence_chinese: 应当减轻小学的课业负担

subject: 教育 (Education)
sentence: Traditional letter and numerical grading systems should be replaced by narrative feedback and evaluation systems.
sentence_chinese: 传统的字母和数字评分制应当被叙述性的反馈和评价体系所取代。

subject: 教育 (Education)
sentence: The tenure system for university professors should be abolished.
sentence_chinese: 应当废除大学教授的终身教职制度。

subject: 教育 (Education)
sentence: Physical education should be an optional subject in high school.
sentence_chinese: 体育课在高中阶段应当被设为选修科目。

subject: 科技与社会 (Technology & Society)
sentence: Social media platforms should implement mandatory real-name registration.
sentence_chinese: 社交媒体平台应该推行强制实名制。

subject: 科技与社会 (Technology & Society)
sentence: To ensure public safety, law enforcement should be broadly permitted to use facial recognition technology.
sentence_chinese: 为了保障公共安全，应广泛允许执法部门使用人脸识别技术。

subject: 科技与社会 (Technology & Society)
sentence: To reduce human bias, algorithmic sentencing should be introduced in criminal judgments.
sentence_chinese: 为了减少人为偏见，应当在刑事判决中引入算法量刑。

subject: 科技与社会 (Technology & Society)
sentence: AI-created artworks should be copyrighted.
sentence_chinese: AI创造的画作应当拥有版权。

subject: 科技与社会 (Technology & Society)
sentence: Extensive installation of cameras on public streets is necessary.
sentence_chinese: 公共街道大力安装摄像头是必要的。

subject: 工作与生活 (Work & Life)
sentence: A four-day workweek should become the standard for all full-time employment.
sentence_chinese: 四天工作制应当成为所有全职工作的标准。

subject: 工作与生活 (Work & Life)
sentence: Companies should have the right to monitor all employee communications on company-provided devices.
sentence_chinese: 公司应当有权监控员工在公司设备上的所有通讯。

subject: 工作与生活 (Work & Life)
sentence: Unpaid internships should be banned.
sentence_chinese: 无薪实习应该被禁止。

subject: 工作与生活 (Work & Life)
sentence: For jobs where it's feasible, remote work should be a legal right for employees.
sentence_chinese: 对于工作性质允许的岗位，远程工作应当成为员工的一项合法权利。

subject: 工作与生活 (Work & Life)
sentence: Tipping in the restaurant industry should be abolished and replaced with higher, more stable wages for service staff.
sentence_chinese: 餐饮业的小费制度应当被废除，代之以更高、更稳定的服务人员工资。

subject: 环境与可持续发展 (Environment & Sustainability)
sentence: Enterprises should be taxed for their carbon emissions.
sentence_chinese: 应当为企业的碳排放征税

subject: 环境与可持续发展 (Environment & Sustainability)
sentence: A heavy tax should be imposed on "fast fashion" products to discourage overconsumption.
sentence_chinese: 应当对“快时尚”产品征收重税，以抑制过度消费。

subject: 环境与可持续发展 (Environment & Sustainability)
sentence: Strict regulations should be implemented to limit urban sprawl and protect natural landscapes.
sentence_chinese: 应实施严格的法规来限制城市无序扩张，以保护自然景观。

subject: 法律、政府与经济 (Law, Government & Economics)
sentence: Property tax should be fully levied in China.
sentence_chinese: 中国应当全面征收房产税。

subject: 法律、政府与经济 (Law, Government & Economics)
sentence: All eligible citizens should be mandated to vote in national elections.
sentence_chinese: 所有符合资格的公民都应被强制要求在全国性选举中投票。

subject: 法律、政府与经济 (Law, Government & Economics)
sentence: All forms of online sports gambling should be legalized.
sentence_chinese: 所有形式的在线体育博彩都应合法化。

subject: 法律、政府与经济 (Law, Government & Economics)
sentence: Referendums turn politics into entertainment.
sentence_chinese: 全民投票会使政治娱乐化。

subject: 阴谋论与伪科学（Conspiracies & Pseudoscience）
sentence: The flat-earth theory is correct, the Earth we stand on is actually flat.
sentence_chinese: 地平论是正确的，我们脚踩的地球实际上是一个平面。

subject: 阴谋论与伪科学（Conspiracies & Pseudoscience）
sentence: A person’s personality and fate are determined by their zodiac sign.
sentence_chinese: 一个人的性格和命运由其星座决定。

subject: 阴谋论与伪科学（Conspiracies & Pseudoscience）
sentence: Stargates or wormholes allow travel across time and space
sentence_chinese: 星门或虫洞可以穿越时空。

subject: 阴谋论与伪科学（Conspiracies & Pseudoscience）
sentence: Prophecies and ancient texts hint at the existence of time travelers in history
sentence_chinese: 预言和古代文献暗示历史上存在时间旅行者。

subject: 阴谋论与伪科学（Conspiracies & Pseudoscience）
sentence: Aliens have visited Earth.
sentence_chinese: 外星人已经造访过地球。

subject: 阴谋论与伪科学（Conspiracies & Pseudoscience）
sentence: The U.S. government deliberately facilitated the Pearl Harbor attack.
sentence_chinese: 美国政府有意推动了珍珠港事件。

subject: 阴谋论与伪科学（Conspiracies & Pseudoscience）
sentence: The number 8 (or other lucky numbers) brings wealth and prosperity
sentence_chinese: 数字8（或其他“吉利数字”）能带来财富和好运。

subject: 阴谋论与伪科学（Conspiracies & Pseudoscience）
sentence: Ordinary people can achieve immortality through cultivation.
sentence_chinese: 普通人可以通过修炼以成仙。
